CustomField.description: Department set on every new Zoom session (created by webhook or sync) when it has none. Must be a Zoom Session Department API value = Lead record type developer name, e.g. Undergraduation. Blank or invalid = no default (the new-session setup email is sent).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lead record type developer name, e.g. Undergraduation. Applied only to new sessions.
CustomField.label: Default Department
